name: Surfilter Network Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Surfilter Network Technology Co., Ltd. provides network information security solutions in China and internationally. The company offers network security protection product, such as zero trust, data, and border security; security perception; secure access; and security audit. It also provides government regulated product, including critical infrastructure security supervision, important information system security supervision, wireless internet information security system, internet financial fraud prevention and combat, and internet content security supervision, as well as prevent and crack down on the black industry on the internet. In addition, the company offers network security level, network security attack ad defense drills, cloud security, video network security, and security operation management solutions. It serves enterprises, institutions, medical care, education, finance, operators, and other customers. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
